item.title: Show HN: Eight: a symbolic, indentation-based programming language
item.summary: Eight is a symbolic, indentation-based programming language that compiles to C11. It reads UTF-32 source files (with BOM) and emits standard C code, which is then compiled with Clang, GCC, or TCC. The language has no keywords: instead, it uses a system of punctuation symbols that combine by meaning. Here is the standard "Hello, World!" entry point in Eight: $f "main" : !> "Hello, World!" !^ 0 !@f "main" Eight is in active development. The language, compiler, and runtime are subject to significant change. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49152494 Points: 1 # Comments: 1
